cards.name: Iname, Death Aspect
cards.oracleText: When Iname enters, you may search your library for any number of Spirit cards, put them into your graveyard, then shuffle.

cards.name: Iname, Life Aspect
cards.oracleText: When Iname dies, you may exile it. If you do, return any number of target Spirit cards from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Iname as One
cards.oracleText:
When Iname as One enters, if you cast it from your hand, you may search your library for a Spirit permanent card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
When Iname as One dies, you may exile it. If you do, return target Spirit permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
